Settings

Display
Bowlby One SC OFL · blocks of two or three words
Text
Courier Prime OFL · all reading text, like a typed page
Moves
tight setting, cut-out blocks, mixed families
Mood
rebellious, handmade, loud, urgent
Case
Display in its small-caps capitals only, in blocks of two or three words; text as typed, lowercase welcome.
Numerals and features
font-variant-ligatures: none; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums

fi fl ff · 1 2 3fi fl ff · 1 2 3

Typewriter text has no ligatures; turn them off so fi and fl stay two letters.
Signature
Words set as cut-out blocks: each display phrase sits on its own ink or red slab, butted edge to edge with no gap and no rotation, over typewriter text.
Use when
Zines, activist and union campaigns, small labels, bookshops, community radio.
Turns into slop when
When the blocks are tilted like stickers, when tape and torn-paper props are drawn in, or when a ransom-note mix of five fonts replaces two.
Offline
Without network the page falls back to the system stacks in --f-display and --f-text; no font files ship with this specimen.
